material_findings.title: NSUCRYPTO 2026 provides a broad-access October cryptography competition lane
material_findings.confidence: high for dates/audience; medium for current actionability
material_findings.summary: The official NSUCRYPTO site announces the Thirteenth International Olympiad in Cryptography for 2026 and states that school students, university students and professionals may participate. It lists an individual online round on Oct. 11 and a team online round from Oct. 12-19, with registration to open in September. This is directly relevant to the suite's cipher/cryptography mission, but current registration state and complete governing/reward terms remain unresolved.
material_findings.recommended_action: Reopen the organizer site and 2026 registration/rules surfaces before promotion. Verify registration-open state, cost, exact eligibility, team-size rules, prizes/recognition, problem/submission mechanics, permitted tools/AI policy, and deadlines. If participation remains open and terms are favorable, create a structured competition case limited to organizer-issued olympiad problems; do not treat unrelated public systems or cryptographic implementations as authorized targets.
